sections.body: Write a program that reads a distance D, computes a slab score, adds a 100-point bonus, and prints the total.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It scores 3 per unit to 50, 5 per unit to 100, 6 per unit to 200 and 10 beyond 200, then adds 100.
